people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: He committed the most detestable acts by going after idols, just like the Amorites whom the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.)
translations.kjv: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Jehovah cast out before the children of Israel.)
